hypothesis_title: Iter 20 — Time Dimension Diversity (Bi-weekly + Intra-month Signal)
hypothesis_description:
Iter 20 — 8 sprint 학습 후 Time 차원 변경. 현 monthly only → bi-weekly rebalance + intra-month tactical signal.

## 동기 (차원 변경: Time)
- 8 sprint (Iter 11-18) 모두 monthly rebalance 동일
- KR market 현 PG2 baseline (monthly STR_1701) 외에 시간 frequency 다양성 미탐색
- Bi-weekly 또는 weekly signal이 monthly에서 capture 못하는 alpha 가능
- Intra-month tactical overlay (예: month-end pressure, 3rd Friday options expiry)

## 핵심 가설
1. **Bi-weekly rebalance** + 같은 alpha source (STR_1701 base) → SR 향상 가능?
   - 가설: monthly→bi-weekly가 alpha decay 절반에서 capture
   - 위험: TO 2x → cost 30bps annual (+15bps cost)
2. **Intra-month tactical signal** (weekly momentum 또는 reversal)
   - 학술: Heston-Sadka 2008 (US monthly seasonality), Kim-Choi 2019 (KR monthly effect)
   - 가설: month-end 4 days가 month-start 4 days 대비 different beta exposure
3. **Time-of-month effect overlay**
   - 가설: 매월 21~23일 (futures expiry 영향) underperformance
   - cash hedge 1주 적용 시 MDD 완화

## 8 sprint 학습 BLOCKING
- L-211 KR linear composite fail
- L-220 vol-reduction Harvey 격하
- L-223 universe restriction alpha vanishing
- L-228 ML tree fail
- L-229 Optimizer mechanism alone insufficient

## 평가 (PG2 baseline 1.4625)
- Bi-weekly variant: SR / cost 30bps 차감 후 net SR > 1.4625?
- Intra-month overlay: month-end cash hedge MDD 완화 효과 + 기회비용
- Net incremental: time-frequency diversification benefit

## 핵심 mandate
- alpha base: STR_1701 multi-sleeve (cor ≥ 0.85 inheritance)
- Universe: KR_top342 (현재 baseline) + KR_TOP500_FREEFLOAT 옵션 (L-227 비교)
- 빈도: monthly (baseline) / bi-weekly / weekly 비교
- Hard caps: max_names 20 / weight [0, 0.20] / Σw=1 / long-only / 2e8 KRW
- cost: 15bps × TO (bi-weekly TO ≈ 12 → cost 1.8% annual!)

## 학술 references
- Heston-Sadka 2008 — Monthly Seasonality in Stock Returns
- Kim-Choi 2019 — KR monthly effect
- Ariel 1987 — Monthly effect in stock returns
- Cooper-Gulen-Schill 2008 — Frequency robustness
